about_the_game:
The original soundtrack of Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade!
Enjoy 26 beautifully composed tracks by IMBA Interactive, blending traditional Japanese sounds with rich fantasy themes.
Available in both FLAC and MP3 formats for a high-quality audio experience that brings every moment of the adventure to life.
